cau_hinh_ca_hoc.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `cau_hinh_ca_hoc` (
  `ca_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `ten_ca` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `gio_bat_dau` time NOT NULL,
  `gio_ket_thuc` time NOT NULL,
  `ghi_chu` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`ca_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

iot_node.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `iot_node` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `ma_node` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `ma_phong` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `ten_node` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `nguon_du_lieu` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MOCK',
  `trang_thai` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OFFLINE',
  `lan_cuoi_nhan` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `chu_ky_gui_giay` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_iot_node_ma_node` (`ma_node`),
  KEY `idx_iot_node_phong` (`ma_phong`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_iot_node_phong` FOREIGN KEY (`ma_phong`) REFERENCES `phong_hoc` (`ma_phong`) ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_iot_node_nguon` CHECK (`nguon_du_lieu` in ('MOCK','REAL')),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_iot_node_trang_thai` CHECK (`trang_thai` in ('ONLINE','OFFLINE','DISABLED')),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_iot_node_chu_ky` CHECK (`chu_ky_gui_giay` > 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

iot_sensor.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `iot_sensor` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `node_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `boot_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `sequence` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `thoi_gian_do` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `thoi_gian_nhan` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `dong_ho_da_dong_bo` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `nguon_du_lieu` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `readings_json` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`readings_json`)),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_iot_sensor_ban_tin` (`node_id`,`boot_id`,`sequence`),
  KEY `idx_iot_sensor_node_thoi_gian` (`node_id`,`thoi_gian_do`),
  KEY `idx_iot_sensor_thoi_gian_nhan` (`thoi_gian_nhan`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_iot_sensor_node` FOREIGN KEY (`node_id`) REFERENCES `iot_node` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_iot_sensor_nguon` CHECK (`nguon_du_lieu` in ('MOCK','REAL')),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_iot_sensor_dong_bo` CHECK (`dong_ho_da_dong_bo` in (0,1)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_iot_sensor_thoi_gian_do` CHECK (`dong_ho_da_dong_bo` = 0 or `thoi_gian_do` is not null),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_iot_sensor_readings` CHECK (json_type(`readings_json`) = 'ARRAY')
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

nhat_ky_he_thong.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `nhat_ky_he_thong` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `ma_sv` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `hanh_dong` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `chi_tiet` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `ip_address` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_agent` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `thoi_gian` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_nhatky_taikhoan` (`ma_sv`),
  KEY `IX_nhat_ky_he_thong_thoi_gian` (`thoi_gian`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_nhatky_taikhoan` FOREIGN KEY (`ma_sv`) REFERENCES `tai_khoan` (`ma_sv`) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=219 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

phieu_muon.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `phieu_muon` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `ma_sv` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `ma_phong` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `ngay_muon` date NOT NULL,
  `ca_muon` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `trang_thai` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' COMMENT 'PENDING, ACTIVE, COMPLETED, CANCELED, OVERDUE',
  `thoi_gian_tao` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `otp` varchar(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `otp_expires_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `thoi_gian_nhan` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `thoi_gian_tra` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `ma_sv_tra` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ma_sv_uy_quyen` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_cabinet_open` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  `tinh_trang_tra` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'BINH_THUONG' COMMENT 'BINH_THUONG, HONG_HOC, MAT_DO',
  `ghi_chu_tra` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `ly_do_huy` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_phieu_taikhoan` (`ma_sv`),
  KEY `fk_phieu_phong` (`ma_phong`),
  KEY `fk_phieu_sv_tra` (`ma_sv_tra`),
  KEY `fk_phieu_sv_uyquyen` (`ma_sv_uy_quyen`),
  KEY `IX_phieu_muon_ca_muon` (`ca_muon`),
  KEY `IX_phieu_muon_ma_sv_trang_thai` (`ma_sv`,`trang_thai`),
  KEY `IX_phieu_muon_phong_ngay_ca_trang_thai` (`ma_phong`,`ngay_muon`,`ca_muon`,`trang_thai`),
  KEY `IX_phieu_muon_thoi_gian_tao` (`thoi_gian_tao`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_phieu_ca_hoc` FOREIGN KEY (`ca_muon`) REFERENCES `cau_hinh_ca_hoc` (`ca_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_phieu_phong` FOREIGN KEY (`ma_phong`) REFERENCES `phong_hoc` (`ma_phong`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_phieu_sv_tra` FOREIGN KEY (`ma_sv_tra`) REFERENCES `tai_khoan` (`ma_sv`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_phieu_sv_uyquyen` FOREIGN KEY (`ma_sv_uy_quyen`) REFERENCES `tai_khoan` (`ma_sv`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_phieu_taikhoan` FOREIGN KEY (`ma_sv`) REFERENCES `tai_khoan` (`ma_sv`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=33 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

phong_hoc.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `phong_hoc` (
  `ma_phong` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `ten_phong` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `tang` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `suc_chua` int(11) DEFAULT 70,
  `trang_thai` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'HOAT_DONG' COMMENT 'HOAT_DONG, BAO_TRI, TAM_KHOA',
  `ma_toa_nha` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`ma_phong`),
  KEY `fk_phong_toanha` (`ma_toa_nha`),
  KEY `IX_phong_hoc_trang_thai` (`trang_thai`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_phong_toanha` FOREIGN KEY (`ma_toa_nha`) REFERENCES `toa_nha` (`ma_toa_nha`) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

tai_khoan.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `tai_khoan` (
  `ma_sv` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `ho_ten` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `mat_khau` varchar(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'BCrypt Hash',
  `sdt` varchar(15) DEFAULT NULL,
  `vai_tro` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SINHVIEN' COMMENT 'ADMIN, GIANGVIEN, SINHVIEN',
  `ten_lop` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `trang_thai` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '1: Hoạt động, 0: Bị khóa',
  `ngay_tao` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`ma_sv`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`),
  KEY `IX_tai_khoan_vai_tro_trang_thai` (`vai_tro`,`trang_thai`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

thiet_bi.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `thiet_bi` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `ten_thiet_bi` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `so_luong` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `tinh_trang` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TOT' COMMENT 'TOT, HONG, DANG_BAO_TRI',
  `ghi_chu` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ma_phong` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_thietbi_phong` (`ma_phong`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_thietbi_phong` FOREIGN KEY (`ma_phong`) REFERENCES `phong_hoc` (`ma_phong`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=24 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

thiet_bi_iot.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `thiet_bi_iot` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `ma_phong` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ten_tu` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `mac_address` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `mqtt_topic` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `trang_thai_mang` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '1: Online, 0: Offline',
  `trang_thai_khoa` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LOCKED' COMMENT 'LOCKED, UNLOCKED, ERROR',
  `firmware_version` varchar(20) DEFAULT 'v1.0.0',
  `lan_cuoi_online` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `mac_address` (`mac_address`),
  UNIQUE KEY `UX_thiet_bi_iot_mqtt_topic` (`mqtt_topic`),
  UNIQUE KEY `UX_thiet_bi_iot_ma_phong` (`ma_phong`),
  KEY `fk_iot_phong` (`ma_phong`),
  KEY `IX_thiet_bi_iot_mang_lan_cuoi_online` (`trang_thai_mang`,`lan_cuoi_online`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_iot_phong` FOREIGN KEY (`ma_phong`) REFERENCES `phong_hoc` (`ma_phong`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=35 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

toa_nha.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `toa_nha` (
  `ma_toa_nha` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `ten_toa_nha` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `so_tang` int(11) DEFAULT 5,

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
